protocol.baseline: registered frequency: exp(linspace(-2,0,n)), not cumulative counts
protocol.scorer_call: call_method with prior-date prefix and aligned history_cutoffs
protocol.fallback: invalid scorer/selection visibly falls back to registered frequency
protocol.other_settings: full history, no blacklist, no base restriction, no recent penalty
protocol.mapping: official LR positions map to pool numbers in ascending numeric order
protocol.targets: 4+, then 5+, then 6 where meaningful; pool and ticket reported separately
protocol.tie_rules: method alphabetic; all-past memory before200; fixed before results
protocol.same_day: score prefixes, training windows and validation boundaries exclude target day
protocol.comparison: nested LR-ticket objective versus nested pool objective, frequency, random
protocol.statistics: one-sided binomial versus exact uniform scheme/pool probability; exploratory paired diagnostic versus frequency
protocol.holm_family: all53 methods plus2 nested rules, both modes, all3 games, both outcomes and all feasible4/5/6 thresholds, both tests
protocol.intervals: 95% marginal Clopper-Pearson; not simultaneous or selection-adjusted
protocol.paired_assumption: exchangeable discordant pairs; diagnostic, not a prospective test
protocol.joker: Urna1 only; Joker-ball categories/prizes are not modeled
protocol.540: six drawn main numbers; five per variant, maximum five ticket hits
